author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
Made solely by me, took my own style and twisted it. Tried to be unique and bring out my new style, but this is a TDM with 2 concepts; -g (which is gear, where you get killrewards) and -b (which is bow oriented, as such.) 

Special Features:
- Each player has his own fort (No teamgriefing possible!)
- When killing a player with your bow, you gain diamond ore.
- The map design is well... bows! Just normal bows, though.
- You cannot go into the water/beyond your fort.
- Everything is enclosed.

Information:
2 Teams (Red vs. Blue)
8 Minutes of play time

The bows have power III and there will be no sword combat. Just take cover and shoot, as you have 2 access points but that may change in the future. You get a furnace to heat up the diamond to craft into armor to survive better.

So... will YOU die in the docks of death?

Download (Ivy please fix build.)
Images
YAML (This is going to be difficult...)




...Trying to twist TDM more with new concepts so you guys enjoy. :c
